title: Improve the static registry format and documentation
description: The current registry is a minimal static JSON file. Improve its structure and add clear documentation so that both humans and agents can understand how projects are listed, what each field means, and how a new project can request to be added.
acceptance_criteria: registry/projects.json has clear and consistent fields
A short registry/README.md (or section in the main README) explains the registry format
The documentation describes the current manual process to request inclusion
